idea-plugin.name: Compare with Diff Anything
idea-plugin.description:
Open two local files or folders in Diff Anything from your IDE, or compare a saved file with its Git HEAD version.

Requires the separately installed Diff Anything 1.6.1 or later on macOS or Windows. The plugin is free; comparisons use your desktop app's Free or Pro features and limits. Purchase or restore Pro in the desktop app.

Files stay on your computer. No network requests, analytics, or AI processing. Git comparisons create a local snapshot; snapshots older than seven days are removed on a later Git comparison.
